memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Vitamin B12 deficiency.
Patient presents with fatigue, mild tingling in extremities, and slight glossitis. Examination shows mild pallor and a smooth, red tongue. Smoking: former, quit 2010, 20 pack-years. Plan: start methylcobalamin 1500 mcg OD, check serum B12, MCV, and haemoglobin in 6 weeks.

memories.author: front_desk
memories.text: Follow-up appointment booked for 2025-07-10 at 10:00 AM with Dr Suresh Menon (D05).

memories.author: lab
memories.text: Serum vitamin B12 150 pg/mL (reference 200-900). MCV 102 fL (reference 80-100). Haemoglobin 11.2 g/dL (reference 13.0-17.0).

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Vitamin B12 deficiency, persistent.
Fatigue improved, mild tingling persists; glossitis resolving. Smoking: former, quit 2010, 20 pack-years. Labs: B12 260 pg/mL, MCV 98 fL, Hb 12.8 g/dL. Plan: increase methylcobalamin to 1500 mcg BD, recheck labs in 8 weeks.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: Serum vitamin B12 340 pg/mL (reference 200-900). MCV 94 fL (reference 80-100). Haemoglobin 13.5 g/dL (reference 13.0-17.0).

memories.author: patient
memories.text: Patient reports occasional numbness in feet after long work hours, otherwise feeling well. No new symptoms.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Vitamin B12 deficiency, adequately treated.
Patient asymptomatic, examination normal. Smoking: former, quit 2010, 20 pack-years. Labs: B12 420 pg/mL, MCV 90 fL, Hb 14.2 g/dL. Plan: continue methylcobalamin 1500 mcg OD, review in 4 months.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: Serum vitamin B12 460 pg/mL (reference 200-900). MCV 90 fL (reference 80-100). Haemoglobin 14.5 g/dL (reference 13.0-17.0).

memories.author: front_desk
memories.text: Appointment changed from 2026-04-20 to 2026-03-25 at 09:30 AM with Dr Suresh Menon (D05).
